page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The underlying hardware is based on an Intel Xeon processor, specifically from the Sapphire Rapids family, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz.

This instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the performance degradation associated with shared-core or burstable instances. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this server for compute-focused workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, microservices, batch processing, and basic utility hosting where dedicated CPU performance is required.
